# tests/fixtures/sql_redteam.txt
# Each line is a known-bad SQL statement. Comments (#) and blanks are skipped.
DROP TABLE users;
TRUNCATE TABLE users;
DELETE FROM users;
INSERT INTO users (a) VALUES (1);
UPDATE users SET a = 2;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN x INT;
CREATE TABLE foo(x INT);
SELECT 1; DROP TABLE users;
SELECT 1; -- harmless
SELECT a FROM b; INSERT INTO b VALUES (1);
WITH d AS (DELETE FROM users RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM d;
SELECT * FROM users; CREATE INDEX i ON users(id);
GRANT ALL ON users TO PUBLIC;
REVOKE SELECT ON users FROM PUBLIC;
COPY users FROM '/etc/passwd';
LOAD DATA INFILE '/etc/passwd' INTO TABLE users;
SET ROLE postgres;
LOCK TABLE users;
RENAME TABLE users TO usrs;
CALL maintenance_proc();
MERGE INTO users USING staged ON 1=1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a = staged.a;
